derive_coco_results: derive COCO evaluation results with per-category AP and seen versus unseen class AP50 metrics
evaluate_coco_bbox: run COCO bounding box evaluation using CustomCOCOEvaluator to compute AP, AP50, AP75, and size-bucketed metrics
evaluate_coco_segm: run COCO segmentation evaluation using CustomCOCOEvaluator to compute AP, AP50, AP75, and size-bucketed metrics
evaluate_zero_shot: evaluate zero-shot detection performance by computing separate AP50 scores for seen and unseen category groups
review_custom_coco_evaluator: review the CustomCOCOEvaluator class that extends COCOEvaluator to add per-category AP tables and seen versus unseen AP50 metrics
